name: folder
description: A solid horizontal folder with a straight negative-space panel divider.
authorship: Original filled geometry constructed for Squircle Icons; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner-requested rounder unboxed folder with the left/right primary edge pair at exactly 2 native units. Both style exteriors span x=2..22 and y=3.31979695..20.68020305, centered at 12,12. Visible aspect ratio is retained from the established Outline family (20 by 17.36040609); the shorter vertical axis is not stretched to force 2px top/bottom margins. Outline uses circular tangent fillets and unchanged Regular 1.70 stroke. Filled exterior is the exact 0.85 outward offset of the same lines and arcs, increasing convex radii and reducing concave radii while keeping arc centers fixed. No enclosing box is added. Folder body corner radii increase to 2.8/3.0 at the top and 3.25 at the base. The tab stays recognizable and its front-panel divider remains straight at y=10.9. The Filled divider gap remains strokeWidth-controlled, independent of the fixed exterior. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved both Outline and Filled after rounder body corners, exact 2px left/right primary margins, retained horizontal proportions and matching unboxed outer contours. Reviewed at native proportions and Regular 1.70.
